player_prompt.intro:
Yu pilai Tower of Hanoi wantaim {num_disks} disks.
Yu mas muvim disks from tower A long tower C.
Long muvim wanpela disk, yu typim tower bilong bikim na tower bilong go (olsem, '[A C]').
Nogat, yu no ken muvim disk i no stap antap, na disk bilong bikpela no ken go antap long disk bilong liklik.
Long taim bilong yu, yu givim wanpela muv.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Yu tokim tower asal o tower target i no stret.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Yu laik muvim disk longpela tower i no gat disk.
invalid_move.same_tower: Yu laik muvim disk i go longpela tower wankain.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Yu traim long putim wanpela bikpela disk antap long liklik dis.

outcome.win: Mi tok amamas long yu, nau yu stretim pinis dispela bikpela hevi bilong Taua Bilong Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Yu putim stret {pct}% bilong ol disks long Taua C.
